name: 1Zpresso JX
details: Hand grinder with internal adjustment: 10 numbers per rotation, 3 clicks per number (2.2 = 2 rotations and 2 numbers).

grindRanges.scale: rotations from zero (burrs closed); 2.2 = 2 rotations and 2 numbers

notes.moka: 1Zpresso groups moka pot with AeroPress and drip coffee maker.
notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “Jx Grind Setting Reference” chart (JX-Grind-Setting-Reference-20200909.jpg on that page), in rotations: Turkish 0.5–0.8, espresso 0.8–1.1, AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 1.6–2.0, siphon/pour over 2.2–3.0, French press 2.8–3.4.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
